output.question: Who is AWS's CTO?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, AWS's CTO is Dr. Werner Vogels. AWS's own Executive Insights page identifies him as “VP & CTO at Amazon.com,” and Amazon's official About page calls him Amazon's chief technology officer. The sources use Amazon.com/Amazon CTO wording rather than explicitly “AWS CTO,” so this identification reflects the executive associated with AWS in the official AWS materials.

key_facts.fact: Dr. Werner Vogels is identified by AWS as “VP & CTO at Amazon.com.”
Amazon's official About Amazon article identifies Dr. Werner Vogels as Amazon's chief technology officer.

passages.quote: Dr. Werner Vogels, VP & CTO at Amazon.com
Amazon's chief technology officer, Dr. Werner Vogels, weighs in on what lies ahead.

caveats: The official sources reviewed describe Vogels as Amazon.com/Amazon CTO and do not use the exact title “AWS CTO”; AWS is the Amazon business associated with the cited materials.
Executive titles can change after the latest page publication or update date.
